Sava Bay Stop is a station of SLT Line 201 and Line 202. It is located at Los Sengas Sava. Passengers may also use this station to change to Nazca Railway The Shuttle (Sava Node) and NR Buses Route R20.[2]

  • Simply Walk Down the Stairs from Platforms 1, 4.

Station Gauntlet Hints[]

 The following text contains large amounts of spoilers. Read with caution.
  • Stars: 2
  • There are three Questions hidden across this station. Perform the challenge in accordance to the Questions.
  • The Station Gauntlet Souvenir comes in the form of a Block of Sand.

Fun Facts[]

  • This Station features the first pair of Basic Platform Screen Doors in Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division.

History[]

  • April 3 2015: This station began services alongside West Ring Line, but Luxter Line Platforms remain reserved.
  • April 4 2015: Luxter Line is established.
  • February 8 2016: This station finished Upgrading Works.[2]
  • December 21 2016: This station completed replacement of direction and platform signs.[3]
  • April 23 2017: This station finished Second Stage Upgrading Works.[4]
  • April 24 2020: Exit C3 is added to this station.[5]
  • January 6 2021: The Luxter Line section of this station completed Second Phase IoM Sign Replacement Works.[6]
  • July 29 2021: Exits B2 and B3 are added to this station, and an elevator is added to Exit C2.[7]
  • March 15 2022: The Station Banners of this station are set up.[8]
  • March 30 2022: The "Station Gauntlet" of this station is set up.[9]

title: Sava Channel
safeHtml:
Sava Channel is one of the Channels in Los Sengas Continent. It is located in Sava District, between Wellsand Sub-District and North Mountain Sub-District. It has connections featuring Nazca Railway, Route, Tunnel connections.

Contents

  • 1 Geographical Location
  • 2 Tunnels and Bridges
  • 3 See Also
  • 4 Citations and References

Geographical Location[]

Sava Channel is located at the north side of Sava, and separates Wellsand Sub-District from North Mountain Sub-District.

Tunnels and Bridges[]

（From North to South）

  • Nazca Railway Luxter Line Wellsand Bridge
  • Route 3 Sava Channel Bridge
  • Nazca Railway West Ring Line The Three Pass Bridge

Sava Coast Station is a station on West Ring Line and Lima Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas Sava. Passengers may also use this station to change to The Shuttle (Sava Node), SLT Line 201, Line 203 (Sava Coast NR Station Stop) and NR Buses Route R20.[2].

Fun Facts[]

  • Exit B of this station was only built after the first Upgrading Works.[4]

History[]

  • March 27 2015: This station began services alongside West Ring Line.
  • February 6 2016: This station finished Upgrading Works.[5]
  • December 20 2016: This station completed replacement of direction and platform signs.[6]
  • April 20 2017: This station finished Second Stage Upgrading Works.[7]
  • July 13 2019: Exit D is added to this station to connect to Sava Node.[8]
  • March 2 2022: The Station Banners of this station are set up.[9]
  • March 18 2022: The "Station Gauntlet" of this station is set up.[10]
  • September 7 2024: This station began expansion of the Lima Line Part.
  • September 9 2024: This station completed expansion.[11]
  • September 10 2024: Lima Line extends from Mayler Airport 1 Station to this station.
  • March 1 2025: This station is chosen as the venue for the March 2025 monthly calender.[12]

title: Sava Light Transit
safeHtml:
Sava Light Transit, abbreviated SLT, is the second largest railway network in Los Sengas behind Nazca Railway. Currently, there are 18 fare zones in operations. While it used to belong to Nazca Railway, it is currently an independent public transport system, and no longer belongs to Nazca Railway.

Fun Facts[]

  • SLT is named after the fact that the first station of this system is located in Sava.
  • SLT is the first separate rail system from Nazca Railway.
  • Most platforms are 50m long, except for the ones in Peckern Continent and Internal Sea.
  • Even when SLT belonged to NR, most lines were not constructed by Nazca Railway, and were constructed by district administrators and developers instead.
  • The SLT system in Asylum pays tribute to the Light Rail System operated by the MTR in Hong Kong with regards that:
    • The system is built before most of the Nazca Railway network reached there (With the exception of Glacier Line, Snowty Line and Mike Line).
    • The Numbering of the SLT Lines in the region pays tribute to the Numbering of the Light Rail Lines in the system in Hong Kong, with the corresponding lines as follows:

Sava Line is Line Number 7A of NR Los Sengas Division. This line has 16 stations, and was established on July 8 2016. With the whole line completing works on July 25 2016, it runs between West Shoal and Peacean Island and has a dedicated Sayler Depot at Sava.

Description[]

Sava Line is the first branch line of NR Los Sengas Division Luxter Line. It runs along Sava, enters the east coast of Sava Channel through the city center of Sava, skirts the southeastern edge of Odyssey, before entering Rover Peninsula.

This route is represented by Dark Green Color on the Nazca Railway Route Map, and is Line Number 7A.

Currently, this route is 17.88 km long, with a total of 16 stations.

History[]

Development Chapters[]

  • S2E5: Savanna Central - North Mountain
  • S3E4: Vanilla Bay - North Mountain
  • S3E12: Vanilla Bay - Horsepower Island
  • S3E14P1: Vanilla Bay - Peacean Island
  • S3E19: West Shoal - Peacean Island

Nazca Railway 2021 Development Outline[]

Direction Development Details Progress
Up Extend from Horsepower Island Station to Peacean Island Station, where it interchanges with Flask Line and a Co-Op Railway line. Peacean Island Station is also the Permanent Up Direction Terminus of this line. Completed
(Chapter: S3E14P1)
Down Extend from Vanilla Bay Station to West Shoal Checkpoint, where it interchanges with West Ring Line and Luxter Line once again. West Shoal Checkpoint is also the Zero Station and the Permanent Down Direction Terminus of this line. Completed
(Chapter: S3E19)

Districts Served[]

  • Sava
  • Odyssey
  • Rover

Line Charcteristics[]

  • This line is the first branch line of Luxter Line.
  • This line was once the longest branch line in Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division at 10.395km. However, this record was later broken in S3E13P2 by Swift Line, another Luxter Line Branch Line when it extended to Vayler Station and became 10.66km long, only to once again keep the record of the longest branch line in S3E14P1 at 16.17km long.
  • This line was the first Nazca Railway Line to adopt the Sub-Standard Railway Standards. However, with the expansion of platform lengths and Platform Gate Installation of its stations between Savanna Central and North Mountain to 204m, this is no longer the case.
  • The Three Pass and Southend were the first two stations involved in Phase 1 (Savanna Central - North Mountain) of this line to have its platforms extended and Platform Gates installed to compliment Phoenix Line development in S3E19, while this line was also extended to West Shoal. Other stations in this section subseqently underwent standardization works as part of Pre-Season 4 Phase 2 Development in anticipation of future development in Odyssey.
  • While this line is the first Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division line to extend despite having completed construction, West Ring Line is the first line to have stations inserted in it despite having completed expansion.
  • Between Savanna Central Station and North Mountain Station, the average interstation distance is shorter, but the interstation distance became normal once again between North Mountain Station and Peacean Island Station.
  • This line holds the record of the shortest interstation distance between Southend Station and Savanna Central Station at 560m long only.
  • All stations along this line between Savanna Central Station and North Mountain Station, as well as Lotusville Station and Gunshot Island Station, contain NR Shops.
  • This line has priority over other lines in terms of completing Second Stage Upgrading Works as the last station (North Mountain Station) completed the works on October 19 2017. During the Updating Works, all platform numbers have been reversed. All Sava Line Platforms to Peacean Island (To North Mountain at the time of the upgrades) changed from Platforms 2, 4 to Platforms 1, 3, and all Sava Line Platforms to West Shoal (To Savanna Central at the time of the upgrades) chaged from Platforms 1, 3 to Platforms 2, 4, while North Mountain Station has exchnged platforms 4 and 5, with the Up Direction and Down Direction of the line reversing as well.[1] However, Nazca Railway did not clearly state the purpose of the platform number change, and rumors of Sava Line merging with Flask Line have not been confirmed either. Ultimately, the two lines are confirmed to transfer at Peacean Island Station without merging.
  • The first phase of the line (from North Mountain Station to Savanna Central Station) commenced its upgrade project over seven years after its completion. The platforms has been extended from 152 meters to 204 meters and platform screen doors have been installed.

References to the Mass Transit Railway in Hong Kong[]

  • The Stations and routes between Lotusville Station and North Mountain Station alludes to the Tuen Ma Line Stations, with the section between Vanilla Bay Station and North Mountain Station using Noise Barrier-styled, semi-confined structures.
  • The Train Arrival Announcements of this line allude to the now-defunct Ma On Shan Line Train Arrival Announcements.

Rolling Stock[]

Sava Line uses N-stock throughout.

Platforms[]

Length[]

In the first phase of the line (between Hillum Station and Southend Station), the platforms were only 152 meters long. However, starting from Vanilla Bay Station, the subsequent platforms were built a length of 204 meters. In 2024, NR officially initiated an upgrade project, extending the platforms of all stations between Hillum and Southend to a length of 204 meters (the standard length of all platforms). It should also be noted that The Three Pass and Southend already ahve platforms that are 204m long during the Phoenix Line expansion. The length of Hillum Station Platform 1 is 223m after standardization.

Platform Screen Doors/Gates[]

In the first phase of the line (from North Mountain Station to Savanna Central Station), platform screen doors were not installed. They were subsequently added to stations starting from Horsepower Island Station. In 2024, NR officially initiated an upgrade project and installed platform screen doors from Savanna Central Station to North Mountain Station. It is worth noting that Vanilla Bay Station had platform screen doors installed one year after its completion, and The Three Pass Station and Southend Station already completed upgrading works during its Phoenix Line expansion.

title: Sava North Stabling Sidings
safeHtml:
Sava North Stabling Sidings is one of the stabling sidings of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division constructed for Phoenix Line. It is located on the west of Odyssey Vista Station. This Stabling Siding is designed to support the train flow needed for Phoenix Line, and is estimated to have a capacity of up to twenty 9-carriage trains.

Contents

  • 1 Description
    • 1.1 Sidings
    • 1.2 Connecting Tracks
  • 2 Fun Facts
  • 3 Gallery
  • 4 Citations and References

Description[]

Sidings[]

The two sides have ten sidings each, which can store twenty trains.

Connecting Tracks[]

The southern end of the stabling sidings connect to Phoenix Line, with access to West Shoal Checkpoint.

Fun Facts[]

This Stabling Siding is located on the ground, and is currently the only Nazca Railway siding which is NOT named based on an existing station.

Savanna Central Station is a station on Sava Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas Sava. Passengers may also use this station to change to SLT Line 202, Line 204 (Savaria Park Stop).

Station Title and Soundtrack[]

  • The Station Title of this Station is Sunbaked Expanse.
  • This Station features two soundtracks that belong to the album "Of Soil and Splendor, Of Jest and Joy".
Name of the Soundtrack Length (mm:ss)
Sunbaked Expanse 01:55
Dusk Over the Burnt Plains 01:55

Fun Facts[]

  • The name of this Station alludes to the Savanna Central in the Movie Zootopia. However, it is named after the fact that this station is situated at the center of Sava.
  • This station alludes to Wu Kai Sha Station of the MTR in Hong Kong,[3] and the arrangement of the Concourse connecting to SLT Platforms is similar to that of Tuen Mun Station.
  • This station is the only station besides of North Mountain Station in Sava Line Phase 1 that was built with platforms that are 204m long.
  • A Plaque to commemorate the completion of Sava Line Phase 1 is seen at this station.

History[]

  • July 25 2016: This Station began services. Sava Line Phase I Completed Construction.
  • October 5 2017: This station finished Second Stage Upgrading Works.[4][5]
  • March 13 2023: The Station Title Banner of this station is added.
  • January 30 2024: The Platform Gates of this station are installed.
  • November 24 2024: This station completed its Station Title and Icon Upgrade Scheme.[6]
  • April 5 2025: The Station Banners of this station are set up.[7]

title: Sayler Depot
safeHtml:
Sayler Depot is a depot constructed for Sava Line in Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division. When Threeler existed as a District, this depot marked the boundary between Sava District and Threeler. However, the entirety of this depot belongs to Sava District.

Description[]

  • Located to the west of Sava Line The Three Pass Station, this depot is the third depot to be built in Nazca Railway.
  • This depot can store 38 4-carriage trains, and features a set of platforms, a maintenance pit and a tiny classification yard.

Fun Facts[]

  • The full name of this depot is The Elevated and Sealed Depot Which is Located Between the Horizontal Boundaries of Sava District and Threeler District.

Scarlet Spring Station is a station on Zephyr Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas Xofa. Passengers may also use this station to change to Mushroom Transit Northward Line (Scarlet Spring Station).

Fun Facts[]

  • When this station was constructed, the Station Number of Zephyr Line was 11-02. However, due to the construction of Speechless Station and to reserve room for future Centopia development, the Station Number is now 11-03. The original Station Number of this station has since been used by Relish South Station.
  • Despite being a ground station, the bridge for Zephyr Line needs to climb to Y=99 to pass over Xofa Line tracks before descending to this station.[3]
  • The arches at the concourse were not part of the concourse. However, as the concourse is constructed, the arches became a decoration of the concourse.[4]

History[]

  • August 17 2019: This Station completed construction.[5]
  • August 18 2019: This Station began services. Zephyr Line is established.
  • November 7 2020: This station completed Second Phase IoM Sign Replacement Works.[6]
  • May 22 2021: Exits D and E are added to this station.[7]
  • December 25 2022: Due to the construction of Speechless Station and future Centopia development, the Station Number of Zephyr Line has changed.[8]
  • March 10 2025: A Shopping Street has been added next to Exit C of this Station.[9]

title: Sea Sky Railway
safeHtml:
Sea Sky Railway, abbreviated as SSR, was one of the operators involved in the Los Sengas Railway Cooperation Scheme. It is a subsidiary of the Sea Sky Corporation, which also had businesses in the real estate market. On March 23 2023, operations of the MetKing Line was handed over to Creeper Railway, and Sea Sky Railway became history.

Seaside Boardwalk is one of the Sub-Districts of Asylum. It is located at the South of the East Coast of Asylum, and its District Code is 29-17.

History[]

Since the beginning of Asylum Development, the Developer ofAsylum has always wanted to build a large-scaled Private Housing Project at the South Side of the East Coast of Asylum with a size rivalling that of Heng Fa Chuen, and that project is named Seaside Boardwalk. Seaside Boardwalk is the last Private Housing Project in Asylum to complete, and is separated in three phases with a total of 82 Blocks that provides a total of 15'496 flats, making it the largest Private Housing Estate in Asylum.

History[]

  • April 27 2015: This station began services alongside New Edward Line.
  • March 8 2016: This station finished Upgrading Works.[5]
  • January 15 2017: This station completed replacement of direction and platform signs.[6]
  • June 8 2017: This station finished Second Stage Upgrading Works.[7]
  • March 2 2022: This station began expansion of the Pegasus Line Part.
  • March 3 2022: This station completed expansion.
  • March 4 2022: Pegasus Line extends from Sincerity Cove Station to this station.
  • May 11 2022: The Station Banners of this station are set up.[8]
  • August 14 2022: The "Station Gauntlet" of this station is set up.[9]
  • April 15 2026: This station completed its Station Title and Icon Upgrade Scheme.[10]

title: Senriyama
safeHtml:
Senriyama is one of the sub-districts of Peckern and mainly consists of residential areas. Before re-construction of this area, Senriyama had a population of 190 thousand, and was the most densely populated area in Peckern Continent at 140 thousand residents per square kilometer.

Contents

  • 1 Geography
  • 2 History
    • 2.1 First Round of Development
    • 2.2 Reconstruction
  • 3 Housing Estates
  • 4 External Access
  • 5 Education
  • 6 Citations and References

Geography[]

Senriyama is located at the south of Heart Peninsula and Landing Pole. It is surrounded by sea on three sides, and is approximately 16km from Downtown. This place was named after the fact that, before development, peaks of mountains extended mile after mile. The area of this place is approximately 0.82 square kilometers, with two-thirds of the development area derived from landscaping works, and one-third of the development area from reclamation.

History[]

First Round of Development[]

Senriyama used to be a small village with a population of only 100, and villagers lived off fishing. However, in 2017, developement of this area commenced, and at the time, Senriyama's sub-districts is divided based on public housing:

  • South Senriyama Estate: South Senriyama Estate is the first public housing estate in Senriyama, and is located at the north of Senriyama despite its name. In total, South Senriyama Estate provides 12'158 housing flats in its 16 buildings, and serves a population of 34 thousand. To the west of South Senriyama Estate is a large shopping mall used for leisure of Senriyama residents. In the middle of South Senriyama Estate also lies a Bus Terminus and a Market.
  • Beak Wood Estate: Beak Wood Estate is located between South Senriyama Estate and Beak Beach Estate. In total, Beak Wood Estate provides 7'612 housing flats in its 20 buildings. However, due to inappropriate planning, complaints from residents were of common occurrence.
  • Beak Beach Estate: Beak Beach Estate is located in the south of Senriyama. It provides 3'696 housing flats in its 13 buildings, and serves a population of 10 thousand. All public facilities in Beack Beach Estate are also considered to be in the Beak Beach Sub-District. It features a car park and a tiny shopping mall.
  • Beak East Estate: Beak East Estate is located in the east of Senriyama, and is an extension of Senriyama. It is named after the fact that it is located to the east of Beak Beach Road. Most of the land in Beak East Estate is from reclamation, and development is now complete. Excluding the 114 detached houses in Phase V, it provides 14'404 housing flats in its 27 buildings for its 40 thousand residents. It is currently the largest sub-district in Senriyama, and many facilities, such as a basketball court, a leisure park, and a public toilet, are available for use of residents. Moreover, Decajoul Catering Corporation had to set up a supermarket in that area due to increasing demand of daily necessities.
  • North Senriyama Estate: North Senriyama Estate is located in the north of Senriyama, and most of its lands is from landscaping works. It provides 3'960 housing flats in its 11 buildings, and serves a population of 11 thousand. However, most North Senriyama Estate residents were dependent on facilities at South Senriyama Estate as development is not yet complete.
  • Charmful Garden: Charmful Garden is located in the north of Senriyama, and is at a good distance from the rest of the properties in Senriyama. It is also a rare instance of private housing in Senriyama. It provides 4'158 housing flats in its 21 buildings for its 12 thousand residents. While it has adequate facilities to be self-sufficient, transportation is not as convenient as other housing properties. In most instances, residents either have to take the SLT for extenal access or walk 400m to the nearest bus terminus. While there were plans for Charmful Garden to be separated from Senriyama, the proposal was rejected.

Reconstruction[]

After much development, Senriyama population became saturated, and further construction of housing properties was no longer feasible. Moreover, inadequate planning meant Senriyama may have to be rebuilt from scratch. Currently, Senriyama has now been re-proposed to include commercial and leisure facilities, as well as the official construction of the Senriyama government building, and to spread out the population density of Senriyama, all in all to increase quality of life.

After reconstruction, some pieces of land that were neglected during the first round of development were able to be utilized and developed, including the current Lam Hong Garden and Beak Pludemet. Moreover, streets within the center area were redesigned into one-way streets and re-organized to alleviate traffic flow, and were named based on the housing estates built in the first round of development for better navigation. However, while reconstruction works were carried out, a few newly constructed buildings also retained properties of their predecessors.

In response to population demand, the South Senriyama Estate Bus Terminus is expanded and renamed "Senriyama (C) Bus Terminus", with new bus termini nearby to alleviate stresses. With the extension of Peckern City Circular to Senriyama Station, the bus termini and other railway routes passing through Senriyama were integrated as a compound development. Thus, Senriyama Shopping Center is born. This building marks the city center and the transport hub of Senriyama. Currently, underground structure and parts of the underground walkway are complete.

Housing Estates[]

  • South Senriyama Estate
  • Beak Wood Estate
  • Beak Beach Estate
  • Beak East Estate
  • North Senriyama Estate
  • Charmful Garden

External Access[]

Currently, Senriyama Station provides railway services for its residents, and many bus companies also set up bus routes in Senriyama to alleviate excess demand due to induced railway demand. In terms of trunk roads, Route 6A and Peckern Viaduct are also designed for road transport demands in Peckern. Moreover, Route 12 is also available for direct access to Downtown.

Education[]

While Senriyama was home to only one secondary school named Senriyama Girls Secondary School, there are further plans to build a primary school near South Senriyama Estate. After repeated petitions, a secondary school for boys was also built in Beak Beach Estate. However, due to the vast population within this district, most students still needed to study in other districts.
